title: Restricted Toeplitz and Hankel Operators
summary: We introduce and systematically study a class of operators that arise naturally due to the Beurling decomposition of the Hardy space $H^2=K_θ\oplus θH^2$. While the compressions of classical Toeplitz and Hankel operators to the Beurling subspace $θH^2$ and the model space $K_θ$ account for the diagonal components of the decomposition, the corresponding off-diagonal operators have remained largely unexplored. Motivated by this, we introduce and analyze a new class of operators, termed \emph{restricted Toeplitz} and \emph{restricted Hankel operators}, acting between Beurling subspace $ηH^2$…
